issues.description: Field 'name' of class Animal: the problem statement / UML declares the attribute as type String, but the solution implementation declares it as a StringBuilder (private StringBuilder name). This is a structural type mismatch for the same conceptual attribute and may confuse students about the expected field type and the signatures/behaviour of the getter and setter.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a String for the Animal.name attribute to match the UML and problem description. Change the field to 'private String name;', assign it directly in the constructor, and update getName() to return a String and setName(String) to accept a String. This preserves intended behaviour while aligning the implementation with the specification and student expectations.
